results.answer: Upwork fixed-price contracts are client-funded into escrow before work starts; after the freelancer submits work the client has 14 days to approve, and silence auto-releases funds, followed by a five-day pending hold before withdrawal (secondary source, 2026). So the owner is paid from client funds without own capital, but cash can arrive up to ~19 days after submission; official Upwork pages returned 403.

facts.claim: On Upwork fixed-price contracts, a funded milestone (client money in escrow) is the prerequisite for payment protection (GigRadar, April 2026).
facts.quote: Funded milestone is the first prerequisite for every Upwork protection.
facts.sourceTitle: Upwork Payment Protection: Fixed-Price Escrow and Milestone Disputes (2026 Free Calculator)

facts.claim: After an Upwork freelancer clicks Submit Work, the client has 14 days to approve, request changes, or do nothing, and silence for 14 days means automatic release (GigRadar, April 2026).
facts.quote: After you click Submit Work, the client has 14 days to approve, request changes, or do nothing.
facts.sourceTitle: Upwork Payment Protection: Fixed-Price Escrow and Milestone Disputes (2026 Free Calculator)

facts.claim: Once Upwork escrow funds are approved or auto-released they sit in a five-day Pending state before withdrawal (GigRadar, April 2026).
facts.quote: Once approved or auto-released, funds go into a five-day Pending state.
facts.sourceTitle: Upwork Payment Protection: Fixed-Price Escrow and Milestone Disputes (2026 Free Calculator)

results.answer: Seattle requires anyone doing business in the city (including professional/personal services and home-based businesses) to hold a Seattle business license tax certificate, $73 for 2026 at under $20,000 revenue; online applications are usually printable within 2-3 business days. Washington State tax registration is required once gross income reaches $12,000/year (or sales tax applies). No broker-specific license was found for brokering freelance services.

facts.claim: Seattle says anyone doing business in Seattle must have a Seattle business license tax certificate, renewed annually by Dec. 31 (seattle.gov, 2026).
facts.quote: Anyone doing business in Seattle must have a Seattle business license tax certificate, also known as a business license or general business license.

facts.claim: Seattle's license certificate is required for providing professional or personal services and for home-based businesses, even if the business is not yet profitable.
facts.quote: Even if you are starting a new business and have not become profitable yet, you must apply for a business license tax certificate and renew it annually.

facts.claim: The 2026 Seattle business license tax certificate fee is $73 for annual Seattle taxable revenue of $0-$19,999.
